topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Walking through the forest, the air is cool and the shadows long. I pause by the stream, listening to the water’s gentle rush. The leaves whisper in the breeze, and the scent of pine fills the air. I notice the sun dipping, painting the sky in soft hues. It’s a time for reflection, for quiet moments. Somewhere, a bird calls, and I watch its flight, admiring the ease of its path. In this moment, there are no worries, only the peace of the forest and the soft pace of my steps.
